No confirmed malicious supply-chain compromise indicators — overall risk: **info**.

Malicious Supply-Chain Indicators

No confirmed malicious supply-chain indicators.

Automatic Execution Paths

  • The provided text does not show .pth, sitecustomize.py, usercustomize.py, install-time setup.py/PEP 517 build hooks, or interpreter-startup auto-execution code.
  • entry_points/CLI functionality may exist, but ordinary console_scripts require user invocation and are not treated as malicious automatic execution evidence.
  • The ~/.bashrc / ~/.zshrc references in README/PKG-INFO appear to be user instructions for making token environment variables persistent; there is no evidence that the package modifies shell profiles itself.

Theft / Exfiltration / Persistence / Lateral Movement / Stealth

  • **Credential harvesting:** No evidence of broad discovery of environment variables, .env files, SSH keys, cloud/CI tokens, wallets, or Kubernetes configs. Qobuz/Spotify token usage appears documented and application-specific.
  • **Archive staging / exfiltration:** No evidence of malicious file collection, archive staging, or external upload.
  • **Persistence:** No evidence of cron/systemd/LaunchAgent/startup-folder installation, shell-profile modification, or other persistence mechanisms.
  • **Lateral movement:** No evidence of Kubernetes, Docker socket, cloud metadata, GitHub Actions/CI token theft, or workflow injection behavior.
  • **Obfuscation/loader:** base64, AESGCM, and gist.githubusercontent.com references were detected, but in the provided context they appear related to music-service API credentials/URLs or a Tidal API mirror list. No eval/exec, dynamic code execution, or download-and-execute loader evidence was identified.

Distribution Integrity Anomalies

  • The provided file list and text do not show unexplained native binaries, hidden payloads, manipulated .dist-info/egg-info contents, typosquatting evidence, or wheel/sdist behavior mismatch.
  • The cryptography dependency appears tied to Amazon/Qobuz encryption-related handling and is not, by itself, malicious supply-chain evidence.

Additional Verification Needed

  • Only selected text from 44 extracted files was provided; a full static review of all omitted files is still needed.
  • Comparing the PyPI sdist against the upstream GitHub repository, and checking whether a separate wheel exists with different behavior, would be needed to rule out artifact/source mismatch.
  • Full contents of pyproject.toml, setup.cfg, entry_points.txt, and SpotiFLAC/__init__.py were not included in the corpus; reviewing them is required to definitively exclude automatic execution paths.
